name: Kureuta
source:
Main character gets invited by uncle to work for his store at a small town. Nostalgia feelings overflow protagonist as he meets childhood friend, cousin and co-workers. But this place bears dark secrets involving prostitution and drugs...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受到叔叔的邀请到他在小镇的商店工作。当主人公遇到儿时好友、表弟和同事时，怀旧之情溢于言表。但这个地方却隐藏着涉及卖淫和毒品的黑暗秘密……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
